item.title: A Proxy Without a Purpose: Hizballah and the Iran Crisis

item.title: In Brief: Increasing Tensions Between China and Japan Create Risks for the Region
item.description: Tensions between China and Japan have been heating up in recent months, sparked in November by a statement from Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi that Beijing interpreted as suggesting that Japan would respond militarily if China attacked Taiwan. Takaichi has pledged to increase Japan’s defense spending, and a major electoral victory in February has strengthened her position.
